def decrypt(encrypted_text, n):
    if encrypted_text is None or encrypted_text == '' or n <= 0:
        return encrypted_text
    length = len(encrypted_text)
    half = (length + 1) // 2
    for _ in range(n):
        decrypted = [''] * length
        decrypted[1::2] = encrypted_text[:half]
        decrypted[0::2] = encrypted_text[half:]
        encrypted_text = ''.join(decrypted)
    return encrypted_text
